project.name: Elocutio
project.description: A private, open-source, bring-your-own-key writing assistant for macOS. Local Harper rules for instant correctness; your chosen model for judgment; a local voice profile that learns how you write.

milestones.name: Planning & foundation
milestones.outcome: Audit, plan, architecture, feature matrix, decisions, prompt library, voice design, brand system, and a compiling repository scaffold.

tasks.title: Product, competitor, and market audit
Build plan: strategy, scope, phase gates, estimates
Architecture: process model, data types, IPC, platform strategy
Brand system, palette, and generated platform icons
Repository scaffold: Rust workspace, crates, CI, governance

acceptance.text: Audit, plan, and architecture are approved and committed
Rust workspace compiles and the CI workflow is in place
Brand system and platform icons are generated from source art

milestones.name: Fork, rebrand, spike
milestones.outcome: Rebranded app builds and runs; overlay works in five apps; an OpenRouter key validates; a minimal LLM rewrite replaces a selection.

tasks.title: Fork Harper v2.13.0, add the upstream remote, write UPSTREAM.md
tasks.notes: Fork documentation, base lock, and upstream remote are in place; the source checkout is local-only.

tasks.title: Rebrand product name, bundle ID, icons, tray, config paths, updater keys, and About
tasks.notes: Product name, bundle ID, generated icons, tray, window copy, issue URL, config path, and About/issue surfaces are rebranded. The updater was removed for M0 and returns in M5 with our own keypair.

tasks.title: Build and run on macOS; verify the AX overlay in TextEdit, Notes, Mail, Safari, and Chrome
tasks.notes: Builds and launches. TextEdit, Notes, and Safari pass the overlay; Chrome and Mail are excluded from AX probing for M0 stability (Chrome needs the M3 extension, Mail needs a text-bounds fallback). Rewrite Selection works in TextEdit, Safari, and Chrome.

tasks.title: Add the elocutio-llm skeleton: OpenRouter client, Keychain, model catalog, key validation
tasks.notes: OpenRouter key validation, Keychain storage, and an in-app rewrite are implemented in apps/macos/src-tauri/src/openrouter.rs. The full provider router and model catalog remain M1.

tasks.title: Prove the end-to-end path: rewrite the selection with AI through the write ladder
tasks.notes: System-wide Rewrite Selection works via ⌥⌘E or the tray menu using a transient/concealed pasteboard string, ⌘V, read-back verification, and text clipboard restore in TextEdit, Safari, and Chrome. The overlay uses the AX fast path for local lints.

tasks.title: Decide IPC ownership and document the main ↔ highlighter protocol
tasks.notes: Decided: the main process owns secrets and network, the highlighter owns text and injection. Protocol framing, messages, and failure handling are documented.

tasks.title: Security audit of inherited network, IPC, updater, and permission surfaces
tasks.notes: Updater removed for M0; the OpenRouter key is in the Keychain and never in config/logs. A full audit of the inherited network/IPC/AX surfaces remains.

acceptance.text: Rebranded app builds and launches on macOS
Overlay works in TextEdit, Notes, Mail, Safari, and Chrome
OpenRouter key validates and is stored in the Keychain
A rewrite replaces the selection correctly via pasteboard + ⌘V, with AX fast path where settable
The suggestion card never steals focus
No Harper branding, bundle IDs, URLs, or config paths remain

milestones.name: LLM MVP
milestones.outcome: Local and LLM suggestions in the focused field, a suggestion card with accept/dismiss, tone detection, onboarding, Keychain storage, and a usage log.

tasks.title: Provider abstraction with OpenRouter and OpenAI-compatible adapters; streaming, retries, error taxonomy
tasks.notes: OpenRouter key validation and non-streaming rewrite work. OpenAI-compatible adapters, streaming, retries, and error UX remain.

tasks.title: Chunking, prompt v1, JSON schema, validation, offset resolver, and dedupe
tasks.notes: Paragraph chunking, prompt p1, JSON schema s1, payload validation, exact/normalized/fuzzy span resolution, dedupe, and rejected-edit reporting are implemented in elocutio-analysis with 18 tests and wired to an in-app Analyze card.

tasks.title: Merge local and LLM suggestions; rank by confidence, severity, and category
tasks.notes: LLM suggestions merge into the existing card and overlapping local spans are suppressed. The widget AI action requests analysis without a shortcut. Confidence/severity ranking remains.

tasks.title: Suggestion card UI: accept, dismiss, explain; inherited local underlines; LLM suggestions in the card
tasks.notes: The inherited card renders local + cached LLM suggestions with accept/dismiss/explain. A compact white widget on every supported focused field shows the count, opens the card, and triggers analysis via an AI action over IPC.

tasks.title: Onboarding: local-only vs provider, key, model, permissions, and playground
tasks.notes: Onboarding checklist checks Accessibility, Keychain provider key, and ⌥⌘E; completion persists so setup opens once.

tasks.title: Settings: providers and models, per-app enablement, privacy, and usage
tasks.notes: Provider model, key, usage, onboarding, and the opt-in Analyze as I write toggle are in Settings. Per-app enablement, privacy controls, and budget warnings remain.

tasks.title: Keychain storage, cost log, and budget warnings
tasks.notes: Keychain storage and a metadata-only cost/usage log work. Budget warnings and model pricing validation remain.

tasks.title: Record accept, dismiss, and edit-after-accept events locally (opt-in) for voice v0
Golden-set harness v0: false-positive rate and span-accuracy metrics
M1 gate: five-app end-to-end run (pasteboard, read-back, undo, offline/402 states, key restart)

acceptance.text: In five apps, including a Chromium-based app, a shortcut produces suggestions
Accept edits the correct span via pasteboard or the AppKit AX fast path; read-back verification passes
Undo works after an accepted suggestion
Invalid key, offline, and 402 states are clear and actionable
Zero user text in logs
The API key survives an app restart

milestones.name: Inline UX + Voice v0
milestones.outcome: Grammarly-style widget, live LLM mode, tone and paragraph rewrites with diffs, cache and cost caps, a hardened 10-app matrix, and a voice profile learned from feedback.

tasks.title: Grammarly-style widget: count, tone, anchors, and per-app positioning
Live LLM mode: debounce, diff-only requests, cancel, stale guard, and throttles
Tone detection, tone rewrite presets, and custom instructions
Paragraph rewrite with word-level diff and accept/reject
Cache, request coalescing, and cost caps
Secure-field and blocklist hardening
Tier A matrix: 10 apps across light/dark, multi-monitor, Spaces, and full-screen
Voice v0: learn traits with confidence from accepted, dismissed, and edited suggestions
Voice v0: style card in rewrites, trait overrides, "sounds like me" rating, and settings tab

acceptance.text: The widget never activates the host app
Underlines align within ±2 pt
Live-mode p95 latency stays under 4 s
Widget position persists when the host window moves
No request storms: coalescing and stale-result guards hold under fast typing
After five accepted or edited suggestions, the profile shows at least three learned traits with confidence and applies to a rewrite
The elocutio-voice copy guard passes

milestones.name: Everywhere + Voice uploads
milestones.outcome: Chrome/Edge extension on Gmail, Notion, Slack, and Linear; assistant panel; compose/reply/summarize; multi-provider support; voice profiles from uploaded samples.

tasks.title: Chrome/Edge MV3 extension: content script, shadow-DOM overlay, popup, background worker
Local bridge: WebSocket, pairing token, Origin allowlist, reconnect, and backpressure
Web adapters: Gmail, Notion, Slack web, Linear, and generic textarea/contenteditable
Google Docs: explicit unsupported state and "copy into Elocutio" fallback
Assistant panel: context chips, streaming, insert/replace
Compose, reply, and summarize flows
Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, and custom OpenAI-compatible provider adapters
Provider routing UI: per-task default, fallback, and budget
Voice uploads: txt/md/docx/paste, quality gates, traits, exemplars, preview, delete, encrypted storage
M3 gate: extension matrix, pairing security, provider switching, and reply insertion

acceptance.text: Extension works on Gmail, Notion, Slack web, Linear, and a plain textarea
Google Docs shows a clear unsupported state with a copy fallback
Pairing is one-time and rejects unpaired origins
Switching provider takes fewer than three clicks
A generated reply inserts at the caret
Three uploaded samples produce a style card with confidence and a preview rewrite
Deleting a sample removes its exemplars and statistics

milestones.name: Personal & trust + Voice v2
milestones.outcome: Style guide, brand voice, glossary, snippets, provenance, local history, AI-phrase linting, translation/humanizer, 24 languages, and per-context voice profiles.

tasks.title: Style guide YAML import/export, regex and term rules, severity, and examples
Brand voice from 3–10 sample documents (few-shot profile)
Glossary, snippets, and personal dictionary UI
Provenance log (typing/paste hashes and AI edits) with export
Local history and analytics (opt-in)
AI-phrase linter: style feedback, not an AI-detector verdict
Translation and humanizer presets; 24-language support
Accessibility and localization pass
Voice v2: per-context profiles, exemplar retrieval, drift detection, export/import, PDF, freeze

acceptance.text: A shared style guide survives restart and is enforced
Provenance data exports cleanly
No AI-detector score is ever shown
Local-only mode works fully offline
Email, chat, and document contexts select the right voice profile
A drifted profile prompts an update
Voice export/import round-trips without loss
PDF ingestion works or fails with a clear message

milestones.name: Launch
milestones.outcome: Notarized DMG, signed updates, Homebrew, documentation, support matrix, privacy and security pages, crash reporting, and a completed security review.

tasks.title: Developer ID signing, hardened runtime, notarization, and DMG packaging
Tauri updater: signing keys, appcast endpoint, stable/beta channels
Homebrew cask, GitHub Releases, and checksums
Docs, website, support matrix, privacy and security pages
Opt-in crash reporting and diagnostics export
Security review: key handling, bridge auth, IPC, dependencies, update verification
Release checklist and rollback plan

acceptance.text: A clean Mac installs from the DMG, grants permissions, onboards, and updates through the app
Gatekeeper passes and the app is notarized
brew install --cask elocutio works

risks.mitigation: Pin v2.13.0, audit the inherited surface, add tests, keep upstream sync, be ready to patch.
Custom design system, native overlay windows, small webviews only for settings and panels.
Reuse Harper geometry, add golden screenshots, keep a widget-first fallback.
Re-read before injecting; pasteboard + ⌘V primary; read-back verify; abort on mismatch; undo; never touch secure fields.
Instant local rules, debounced or on-demand LLM, caching, a cheap default model, and budget caps.
Quote-based schema, local resolution, ambiguity rejection, and a repair loop.
Keychain only in the main process, redaction, and no keys in highlighter logs.
127.0.0.1 only, pairing token, Origin allowlist, and close on quit.
Small isolated patches, contribute generic fixes upstream, quarterly base review.
Phase gates, explicit non-goals, and the deferred list are enforced at each milestone.
